caption:
The Full Moon in Gemini has a lot to say.

The Moon moved into Gemini early this morning and turns full there mid-morning. She meets Uranus around midday and sends Saturn a friendly sextile tonight. Swipe for Gemini, Libra and Aquarius, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Air friend. 🌙

#airsigns #gemini #libra #aquarius #moonjournal

slides.body: The Full Moon peaks in your sign this morning, then meets Uranus, also in Gemini, around midday. Let yourself be seen.
slides.question: What part of me is ready for the spotlight?

slides.body: The Full Moon lights your house of travel and big ideas. Venus, your ruling planet, is in your sign: dream generously.
slides.question: Where would my heart travel if I let it?

slides.body: The Full Moon glows in your house of joy. Late this morning she sends Pluto, in your sign, a friendly trine: play a little.
slides.question: What lights me up when no one is watching?

slides.headline: Save this for Full Moon night.
